I can't confirm that the man who invented both the Forstner bit and an electric motor was born in Hartford County, Connecticut. The shared note gives no source, and I know of no record that the Forstner bit's inventor, Benjamin Forstner, built an electric motor, so the question's premise still looks mistaken or conflated. I'd need a reliable biography or patent record to name a county and state.

CONFIDENCE: 15
